market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.55 and falling, July CPI in line at 0.1% m/m and yields easing on soft wholesale inflation. Oil is the live macro story.

oil_gas.catalyst: Oil prices rise as attacks dent hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening (Al Jazeera, 2026-08-12); stalled talks escalating, XOM long continues
oil_gas.reasoning: Hormuz re-escalation is an ongoing supply story, not a one-day move; XOM has lagged crude (stock +5% vs WTI +11% in 5 days), so some pass-through is still unpriced. A deal announcement would reverse it.

gold_miners.reasoning: NEM up 24% in 20 days; settlement and gold rebound are priced. Newmont-Headwater and analyst pieces are not catalysts. Gold remains below its 200-day average with yields near highs.

chips.reasoning: Only a technical-levels headline on NVDA and a sector bounce; no named catalyst. Flat.

pharma.catalyst: Lilly guidance raise on 2026-08-05 (from handoff); post-guidance drift with no negative news in the headlines
pharma.reasoning: Continuing the existing hold through its window (exit about 2026-08-19). The headlines show no drug-pricing shock; modest confidence only, since the stock is near its high.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none confirmed: Reuters 'COMMENTARY: Copper's Congo panic says more about copper than Congo' (2026-08-12) suggests the ban shock is being discounted
copper_uranium.reasoning: The Reuters piece argues the Congo reaction was overdone, and copper has slipped 1.6% in 5 days while FCX is flat. The unpriced-supply-shock case from the last note has weakened, so exit.

would_change_my_mind: A Hormuz deal would end the XOM long; a confirmed Congo export ban with copper rallying would revive the FCX long; a lilly-specific negative headline would end the LLY hold.

handoff.what_changed: Oil rose to WTI 83.27 (+10.7% in 5 days) as attacks dented Hormuz reopening hopes. A Reuters commentary says copper's Congo panic was overdone, and copper slipped 1.6% in 5 days. July CPI came in at 0.1% as expected and yields eased.
